services.desc: J. Ellison Carrol of Big Lake, Texas, is responsible for the statement that the first rodeo held in Texas was at Canadian in the summer of 1888. It was in the form of a two day celebration, with steer roping as the main event. To Hemphill County belongs the distinction of innovating rodeo and was among the first of such “reunions” to be staged as a community undertaking anywhere in the southwest. In this time before the Anvil Park Rodeo, this event stands as an unmarked memorial of the people who settled this region.
